t: The question put to the people of the Garden
a: فَيَقُولُ هَلْ رَضِيتُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ وَمَا لَنَا لاَ نَرْضَى يَا رَبِّ وَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتَنَا مَا لَمْ تُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
p: Fa-yaqūlu hal raḍītum. Fa-yaqūlūna wa mā lanā lā narḍā yā rabbi wa qad aʿṭaytanā mā lam tuʿṭi aḥadan min khalqik
m: He says: are you pleased? They say: and why would we not be pleased, our Lord, when You have given us what You have given no one else of Your creation.
